name: Knott's Prop Shop Pizzeria Warm Breadsticks or Mozzarella Moons (Skip Marinara Dip)
brandOrRestaurant: Prop Shop Pizzeria (The Boardwalk · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: Soft baked white-dough breadsticks provide quick carbs with zero roughage when you skip the acidic red marinara dipping cup.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the warm breadsticks plain (wipe off excess garlic-herb butter if sensitive) and skip the marinara cup.
watchOuts: Mozzarella Moons are breaded and fried—take lactase and save for remission
